name: Campaign Finance - Transaction Detail
description: This table lists individual transactions as reported on the Texas Ethics Commission C/OH Form. Each row represents an individual filer's transaction, which may be a loan, expenditure, credit, pledge or contribution. For information about each report filed, please visit the Reports Table at: Campaign Finance - Report Detail A data dictionary for this dataset is available at Campaign Finance Data - Data Dictionary * This dataset may not receive new data daily. "Data Last Updated" reflects the date of when new data was published.

approvals.message: The `strict_permissions` flag must be on to enable internal approvals.

columns.name: Transaction_Type
columns.description: Identifies the type of transaction reported: Loan, Expenditure, Credit, Pledge, or Contribution.

columns.name: Filer_Name
columns.description: Name of individual, committee or entity filing the report. This name is a standardized format used by the Office of the City Clerk to ensure all of a filer's reports are accessible under a single name

columns.name: Transactor_Name
columns.description: The transactor's name (for individuals) or the name of the company, political committee, organization, or group (for entities).

columns.name: Entity
columns.description: Identifies the transactor as either an entity (such as a company, political committee, organization, or other group) or an individual person

columns.name: Transaction_Amount
columns.description: Amount involved in the transaction. Amounts will be listed as a negative (-) for expenditures.

columns.name: Date_Filed
columns.description: Date the structured data file was received by the Office of the City Clerk

columns.name: Correction_Flag
columns.description:
If the transaction is reported on a Correction Affidavit, the correction flag will contain either NEW, or MODIFY.  

NEW indicates the transaction is newly reported, 

MODIFY indicates the transaction is a modification of a previously reported transaction.

For credits, a description of the purpose for which the amount was received. For expenditures, a description of the activity conducted by making the expenditure.

columns.name: Transactor_Employer
columns.description: The transactor's employer (for individuals)

columns.name: Transactor_Occupation
columns.description: The transactor's occupation (for individuals)

columns.name: Financial_Institution
columns.description: For loans, if the lender is a financial institution, this field is marked ‘Y.’ This field is marked ‘N’ for any other type of lender.

columns.name: Interest_Rate
columns.description: For loans, the interest rate of the loan.

columns.name: Maturity_Date
columns.description: For loans, the final maturity date of the loan.

columns.name: Collateral
columns.description: For loans, a description of the collateral, if applicable

columns.name: Personal_Funds
columns.description: When marked ’X,‘ indicates that the loan is a deposit of personal funds into an account in which political contributions are held.

columns.name: Guarantor
columns.description: For loans, if there is a guarantor, this field will be marked ‘Y.’ When this is marked ‘N,’ it indicates that there is no guarantor for the loan.

columns.name: Guarantor_Name
columns.description: For loans, the name of the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Guarantor_Address
columns.description: For loans, the address of the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Guarantor_City_State_Zip
columns.description: For loans, the city of the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Amount_Guaranteed
columns.description: For loans, the amount guaranteed by the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Guarantor_Employer
columns.description: For loans, the employer of the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Guarantor_Occupation
columns.description: For loans, the occupation of the guarantor, if applicable.

columns.name: Travel_Outside_Texas
columns.description: When marked ‘X,’ indicates that a transaction is for travel outside the state of Texas.

columns.name: Political_Obligation
columns.description: For an unpaid incurred obligation reported on F2, or a credit card expenditure reported on F4, ’Y’ indicates  the expenditure was political.

columns.name: Reimbursement_Intended
columns.description: If the filer intends to be reimbursed for this expenditure, this field will be marked ‘Y.’

columns.name: Returned_to_Filer
columns.description: If the transaction was a political contribution returned to the filer, this field will be marked ‘Y.’

columns.name: Out_Of_State_PAC
columns.description: For contributions, pledges, or loans, if the contributor or lender is an out-of-state political committee (PAC), this field will be marked ‘Y.’

columns.name: Out_of_State_PAC_ID
columns.description: For contributions, pledges, or loans, if the contributor or lender is an out-of-state political committee (PAC), the committee's Federal Election Commission (FEC) identification number.
